$comment: Authoritative value list for every enum that v1 spells out at more than one schema location, plus each site that must spell it identically. There is no shared enum $def anywhere under artifacts/schemas: every enum is repeated literally, which is the established convention, and its failure mode is silent divergence -- a value added to the object schema and forgotten in the payload schema yields two implementations that disagree while both still validate. check_repeated_enum_drift treats this file as the baseline and enforces the value list and its order at every registered location; a location that no longer carries an enum is an error, so a rename or a move must update this registry rather than silently drop coverage. A nullable site spells the enum inside a oneOf branch and is resolved automatically -- the null branch is never part of the value list, because a null inside the enum itself would read as an extra value on the axis and the naming lint rejects it. Only enums that are genuinely one enum belong here: the object `state` field is NOT registered because its value sets differ per object by design (Strand/Morph active|archived|redacted, Space/Circle active|archived|tombstoned, Relation active|tombstoned, Message active|redacted); registering those together would invite a future editor to unify them, which would widen Message's lifecycle.

enums.name: object_stage
enums.rationale: Business-progression stage. common-fields.md 5.3.2 freezes it at 8 values and 1752 ruled it the only cross-implementation carrier in v1, so a drifted copy is an interoperability break rather than a cosmetic one.
